add.hint: Paste any link — direct files, YouTube and other video pages all work.
card.confirmDeleteFile: Delete the file from disk too?
dialog.batchHint: One link per line — videos, files and magnet links all work.
dialog.clipInvalid: Check the clip times — end must be after start and inside the video.
dialog.noSubtitles: No subtitles available for this video
dialog.thumbnailOnlyHint: Downloads just the thumbnail image (.jpg) — no video.
dialog.title: Add download
dialog.torrentNote: Torrents are supported only for legal content — e.g. Linux ISOs and public-domain media. DOVIRA never seeds after a download finishes.
empty.hint: Paste a link above and press Add — or press Ctrl+V anywhere.
empty.title: No downloads yet
error.bridge: The app's internal connection didn't start — close and reopen the app.
error.drm: This video is DRM-protected and can't be downloaded.
error.engine-missing: Download engine (aria2) is missing. Reinstall the app.
error.forbidden: The site is blocking the download (403).
error.invalid-url: That doesn't look like a valid link.
error.loginRequired: This video needs a login. Turn on cookies in Settings > Browser & Cookies.
error.renameLocked: The download finished, but Windows locked the file while saving it. Press Retry.
error.resumeMismatch: The previous download's state doesn't match, so it has to start from the beginning. Press Retry to restart it.
error.resumeNote: Some servers don't support resume — on those, a stopped download restarts from the beginning. That's the server's limit, not a bug.
error.unavailable: This video can't be found or is private.
error.unsupported-url: Only http:// and https:// links are supported.
error.updateFailed: Engine update failed — the old version is still running.
error.updateForbidden: The update server refused the download (403). Try again later.
history.clear: Clear history — records only, files stay
history.clearConfirm: Delete all finished download records? The files on disk stay — only the history list is cleared.
history.deleteConfirm: Delete this record from history? The file on disk stays.
history.empty: No history yet — finished downloads will appear here.
history.title: History
list.name: Name
scheduler.countdownNote: Downloads are finished. You can cancel before the timer ends.
settings.archiveEmpty: The download archive is already empty.
settings.autoUpdateEngines: Auto-update yt-dlp when a new version is out
settings.bridgeError: The app's internal connection didn't start — close and reopen the app.
settings.clipboardWatchHint: When a download link is copied, DOVIRA shows a toast with an Add button. Nothing is downloaded automatically.
settings.cookiesHint: For videos that need a login. Your browser cookies are read locally — nothing is uploaded.
settings.initTimeoutError: Loading settings is taking too long — press Retry, or restart the app.
settings.loadError: Settings couldn't load — the app couldn't reach its own data. Press Retry, or restart the app.
settings.minimizeToTray: Close to tray instead of quitting
settings.playlistSkipDownloadedHint: Playlists and batch downloads skip videos already in the download archive.
settings.proxyHint: Applies to all downloads. Leave empty for no proxy. Formats: http://, https://, socks5://, socks5h://
settings.schedulerEnable: Start the queue at a set time
settings.schedulerNote: The PC must be on and DOVIRA running at that time. The action runs only after the queue finishes, with a 60-second countdown you can cancel.
settings.title: Settings
toast.clipboardLink: Link copied — add it to DOVIRA?
toast.engineDied: Download engine stopped unexpectedly. Resume to continue.
toast.initFailed: Something failed to load — check Settings for details.
